omega_ui_por_el_escaneo_diario_sin_evalu: by the daily scan and not evaluated yet. Each evaluation makes a real DeepSeek call (about $0.001–0.003). Select signals to remove them; you choose which are included.
omega_ui_sin_decidir_todavia_incorporar_: Not decided yet: you choose whether to include it or keep it out.
omega_ui_el_agente_detecta_rupturas_y_su: The agent detects breakouts and makes suggestions; you trade manually and record them here.
omega_ui_sin_caducidad_pasados_21_dias_s: No expiry: signals are marked "caution" after 21 days (75th percentile of days to target among historical winners).
omega_ui_senales_ya_resueltas_mas_las_qu: Resolved signals plus dismissed signals still running, so you can see what would have happened. The checkbox records whether you actually traded.
omega_ui_tickers_fuera_del_universo_fijo: Tickers outside the fixed universe can enter through ApeWisdom (Detect breakouts, using social mentions) or be added manually (Add ticker). Sector and statistics are automatic; the gate is the only real call, evaluated one candidate at a time.
omega_ui_cada_ticker_con_su_resultado_re: Each ticker shows its actual cumulative result. Disabling one removes it from alerts and counts but keeps it in daily scans, so you can see whether it improves and reactivate it.
omega_attr_por_que_entras_que_vigilar: Why you are entering, what to watch…
omega_attr_coste_de_compra_de_lo_que_sig: Purchase cost of current open holdings, excluding cash and current market value.
omega_attr_proveedor_del_gate_candidatos: Gate provider for candidates and signals. Remains selected until you change it; no automatic switch if a provider fails.
omega_universe_health_help: How the universe’s tickers have performed on average over the past 3 months.
omega_regime_below_help: Below this level, the sector has been declining independently even when the market is doing well. This is informational and does not block entries.
omega_regime_reference_help: For reference only; it does not block entries.
omega_connection_failed: Unable to connect to the backend.
omega_scan_failed: The scan could not be started.
omega_operation_failed: The trade could not be recorded.
omega_gate_failed: The gate could not be started.
omega_position_failed: The position could not be recorded.
omega_candidate_search_failed: The candidate could not be found.
omega_action_failed: The action could not be completed.
omega_gate_completion_failed: The gate could not be completed.
omega_change_failed: The change could not be saved.
omega_regime_origin: The universe basket was at {value}% over 60 sessions when this signal appeared. The regime gate would have blocked it.
omega_regime_snapshot: A snapshot of its entry date, not a live warning.
omega_gate_busy: Another signal is being evaluated. Wait for it to finish.
omega_strongest_pattern: This signal combines zigzag and double bottom: the strongest in the group.
omega_other_strongest: Another signal combines zigzag and double bottom. Review it first.
omega_choose_pattern: None combines zigzag and double bottom. You decide.
omega_existing_scan: A scan was already running. Following its progress.
omega_pending_signal_summary: {count, plural, one {# signal} other {# signals}} from the fixed universe, detected by the daily scan, awaiting evaluation. Each evaluation makes a real DeepSeek API call (~$0.001–$0.003). Tap a signal to deselect it.
omega_candidates_ready: {count, plural, one {# ApeWisdom candidate has passed its filters and is awaiting your gate.} other {# ApeWisdom candidates have passed their filters and are awaiting your gate.}}
